quarterly_data.signal: Duos Technologies 8-K: Duos sold its rail technology subsidiary Duos Technologies, Inc. (DTI, historically the Technologies segment) to Sandbank Acosta, LLC under a Stock Transfer Agreement entered August 5, 2026 and effective as of June 30, 2026; DTI now operates as the privately held DuosTI. The sale was approved as a related-party transaction because interim CFO Adrian Goldfarb holds a 50% membership interest in the purchaser. Duos provides DTI human resources, payroll, benefits and accounting support under a Transition Services Agreement through December 31, 2026 (cost plus a 5% handling fee) and leases certain employees to DTI. Duos describes DTI as operating the largest installed base of Railcar Inspection Portals in North America.
quarterly_data.figure: effective June 30, 2026; 50% interest; services through December 31, 2026
